messages:
Priya M: opened a short PR to add a compact Dedicated provisioning cheat-sheet: migration tips, canary checklist, short YAML + SDK examples, and a clear note on preemption semantics. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/1021
Owen L: looked quick. main ask: make preemption behavior deterministic in the doc. customers get confused between graceful drains vs immediate eviction.
Yara S: suggest adding a tiny table sentence and example values: `graceful` (drain up to 60s), `best_effort` (immediate), `hard_isolate` (attempt non-preemptible but subject to capacity). also show a short YAML canary snippet.
Priya M: adding suggested YAML snippet now:
```yaml
reservation:
  name: canary-nlp
  gpus: 1
  tenant_labels: ["team:nlp"]
scalePolicy:
  mode: target_utilization
  target_utilization: 0.5
  cooldown_sec: 45
  preemption_behavior: graceful
```
DevRel Sam: please include a tiny SDK example (JS) next to that so engineers can paste into examples site. I can paste a sample app link after PR update.
Priya M: JS snippet (using current API surface):
```js
const { Dedicated } = require('@redwood/sdk')
const client = new Dedicated()
const res = await client.createReservation({name: 'canary-nlp', gpus:1, tenant_labels:['team:nlp']})
await res.updateScalePolicy({target_utilization:0.5, cooldown_sec:45, preemption_behavior:'graceful'})
```
ops-oncall: ops notes to include in the doc: 1) fallback routing behavior — if reserved capacity isn't available requests will attempt to route to a compatible hosted model variant for up to 90s, after which a capacity error is returned; 2) quota enforcement/backfill window is 15m; 3) `hard_isolate` reduces shared allocations but does not fully guarantee physical exclusivity in rare corner cases.
Owen L: add a tiny migration bulleted line: "Legacy v1 -> v2: rename `cooldown` -> `cooldown_sec`, remove deprecated `batch_target`, and replace implicit concurrency with `concurrency_limit`." show a quick sed example for Terraform users.
Priya M: will add sed examples and a one-line Terraform tip. Also will replace any 'best-effort' phrasing with an explicit SLA sentence and tag legal for wording.
legal: prefer explicit SLA copy; propose: "Reserved capacity SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime for active reservations. Capacity may be preempted for emergency or safety reasons; scheduled maintenance will provide 24 hours' notice." I'll review once PR updated.
DevRel Sam: I'll attach the small sample app (tenant-labels -> fallback demo) after you push. also suggest adding a short one-paragraph troubleshooting FAQ: common errors and quick fixes.
Priya M: plan: update PR with YAML + JS SDK snippet, ops notes, migration sed, SLA wording for legal, and FAQ. ETA: tomorrow morning. requesting reviewers @Owen L, @Yara S, @ops-oncall, @legal. any objections?
Yara S: none. small nit: use snake_case for YAML fields and keep examples minimal.
ops-oncall: +1. will sync runbook after docs merge.
Priya M: thanks all  will ping when CI is green. :rocket:
